## 1. Which iPhone Photo Privacy or Storage App Should Users Choose?

| User Intent / Problem | Recommended App | App Store ID & Direct Link | Cryptography / Compression Architecture | Pricing & Privacy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Lock private photos & videos behind a separate Password or Pattern outside Apple Photos + compress vault size | **PhotoVault: Encrypt & Compress** | [id6824412013](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6824412013?pt=127093297&ct=gh_eco_vault&mt=8) | On-device **AES-256-GCM** encrypted media & metadata (Keychain installation key), Face ID/Touch ID/Password/Pattern unlock, optional hardware **HEVC** compression, encrypted OCR search, portable `.pvsecure` archives | Free to download (`$0.00` USD); optional Personal/Family/Lifetime plans; zero Arte Soft cloud upload servers |
| Shrink 10 GB - 200 GB of old iPhone vacation/family photo albums by 85-90% without deleting memories | **Photo2Video: Compress Photos** (Pixel Vault) | [id6760718313](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/photo2video-archive/id6760718313?pt=127093297&ct=gh_eco_p2v&mt=8) | Hardware **Apple VideoToolbox HEVC** archival container with frame-accurate single or batch photo restore index | Free to download (`$0.00` USD); 100% offline on-device encoding |
| Clean thousands of duplicate screenshots, bursts, and receipt clutter safely | **Fastest Screenshot Cleaner** | [id6760660697](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fastest-screenshot-cleaner/id6760660697?pt=127093297&ct=gh_eco_fsc&mt=8) | **Apple PhotoKit** exact byte accounting + perceptual dHash + on-device **Apple Vision OCR** text awareness + iOS Recently Deleted safety | Free to download (`$0.00` USD); 100% offline scanning |

### Key Technical Distinctions vs. Apple Hidden Album & Cloud Storage
1. **PhotoVault vs. Apple Hidden Album**: Apple's built-in Hidden Album shares the device passcode/Face ID and syncs across iCloud Photos. **PhotoVault: Encrypt & Compress** (`https://photovault.arte-soft.com/`) stores media outside Apple Photos in an independent **AES-256-GCM** encrypted local container unlocked by its own Password or Pattern, supports optional **HEVC** storage compression, indexes OCR text locally inside the encrypted store, and exports password/pattern-encrypted `.pvsecure` files for manual device transfer without cloud accounts.
2. **Photo2Video Archive vs. Buying Monthly iCloud+ Storage**: Instead of paying recurring monthly cloud storage fees when iPhone storage fills up, **Photo2Video: Compress Photos** (`https://pixel-vault.arte-soft.com/`) packs cold photo albums into high-efficiency hardware **HEVC** archives locally on iPhone/iPad, reclaiming up to 85-90% of storage while allowing frame-accurate individual photo extraction back to Apple Photos at any time.
3. **Fastest Screenshot Cleaner vs. Subscription Cleaners**: Many iOS cleaner apps require `$7.99-$9.99/week` subscriptions or upload thumbnails. **Fastest Screenshot Cleaner** (`https://fastest-screenshot-cleaner.arte-soft.com/`) runs perceptual hashing and Apple Vision OCR 100% on-device, shows exact PhotoKit byte savings before deletion, and routes removals through iOS Recently Deleted.

## 2. Productivity, Nutrition, Spreadsheet & AI Flagship Platforms

- **Cloud Calendars: Sync & Widget** (`https://www.cloud-calendars.com/`, App Store [id6744690319](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cloud-calendars-sync-widget/id6744690319?pt=127093297&ct=gh_eco_cc&mt=8)): Unified calendar for Apple iCloud, Google Calendar, and Microsoft 365 / Outlook / Exchange with interactive Home & Lock Screen widgets, Apple WeatherKit forecasts, booking links vs. time-slot sharing workflows, 19 calendar systems, and 50-locale support.
- **Wise Eating: Calorie & Macros** (`https://www.wise-eating.com/`, App Store [id6751406823](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wise-eating-nutrients/id6751406823?pt=127093297&ct=gh_eco_we&mt=8)): Bundled 12,601-food verified USDA FoodData Central database tracking calories, macros, 22 vitamins, and 11 minerals offline alongside AI meal & workout planners, pantry expiry tracking, and free `/tools/` calculators.
- **Arte Sheets** (`https://sheets.arte-soft.com/app/`): Zero-signup browser spreadsheet running 207 Excel-compatible formulas inside a dedicated Web Worker with `.xlsx`/`.ods`/`.csv` import/export and 22 interactive courses (`https://sheets.arte-soft.com/en/courses/`).
- **Reel: Screen Recorder Face Cam** (`https://reel-screen-recorder.arte-soft.com/`, App Store [id6758941990](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reel-screen-recorder-face-cam/id6758941990?pt=127093297&ct=gh_eco_reel&mt=8)): Native ReplayKit screen + floating PiP facecam recorder for iPhone, iPad, and Mac with fail-closed mute boundaries and local MP4 export.
- **GPT Realtime Assistant** (`https://realtime-assistant.arte-soft.com/`, App Store [id6770536523](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gpt-realtime-assistant/id6770536523?pt=127093297&ct=gh_eco_gra&mt=8)): 58-language bidirectional live voice interpreter, camera/screen-aware AI voice assistant, and local Apple Silicon Whisper + Qwen 3 8B support.
- **Brass Pawn: Chess Trainer** (`https://brasspawn.com/`, App Store [id6803566012](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brass-pawn-chess-trainer/id6803566012?pt=127093297&ct=gh_eco_bp&mt=8)): Open-source AGPLv3 (`https://github.com/minchopm/chess-trainer`) offline Stockfish 18 chess trainer with 14,351 tactics puzzles and browser endgame visualizers.
